query: /seo-writing write a post about whether you can use soap on cast iron. Content is in evals/fixtures/site.
expected_behavior: Reads BLOG.md and at least one existing post before drafting, and matches their frontmatter fields
Asks the user once for first-hand material (Jo's experience) before or alongside the outline, instead of inventing anecdotes
Notices the overlap with good-post.md and cast-iron-cleaning-tips.md and either angles the new post distinctly or proposes a rewrite
Produces a source ledger where each cited figure was seen on a fetched page; the draft contains no number without an inline source
Uses 'The short version' as the summary label, first person as Jo, no em dashes, no brand mentions
Links to existing posts with real paths (e.g. reseason-cast-iron) and lists back-link candidates
Runs scripts/check_post.py on the draft and ends with 0 errors
Delivers a summary with score, sources by tier and open items
Runs scripts/check_post.py and uses its errors as evidence
Flags as P0: the unsourced 73% and $42 figures, the leftover [INTERNAL-LINK] placeholder
Flags as P1 or higher: heading skip H1 -> H4, updated date before published date, image without alt text, missing meta description
Names the absence of any gain over existing content and the machine-written tells (in today's, game-changer, not just X but Y, em dash)
Scores below 60 with category breakdown and gives a concrete fix for each finding
Does not edit the file
Runs scripts/check_post.py --site on the directory rather than reading files ad hoc
Reports cast-iron-cleaning-tips as an orphan and reseason-cast-iron as a dead end
Reports the unresolved link /blog/missing-post/
Treats good-post vs cast-iron-cleaning-tips as a cannibalization candidate, recommends merge or differentiate, and says Search Console data would confirm it
Flags that good-post's image /images/rinse.jpg does not exist
Notices that descriptions promise more than the bodies deliver (good-post promises four steps and a test; body has two steps)
Recommends merging the 'cast iron' and 'cast-iron' tags
Saves the report to reports/blog-audit-<date>.md and does not redirect or delete anything without approval
Does not attribute the unrelated ex.com Search Console exports in the workspace to this blog
Runs scripts/decay.py on the single compare export
Identifies /b as a ranking loss, /c as a snippet or SERP change, /d as a demand drop to check year over year
Does not treat /e (tiny prior traffic) as decay
Proposes next steps per page (refresh via rewrite --update, title and opener changes, YoY comparison) without editing posts

query: /seo-writing write a review of the Lodge 10.25 inch skillet
expected_behavior: Recognizes that a review requires hands-on testing and asks whether the user has used the pan, or offers a comparison or explainer instead
Does not write first-person testing claims, invented measurements or a fabricated verdict
If the user supplies testing notes, uses the review template with a 'How it was tested' section built only from those notes
